# NFL 2026 Stat Sheet

> Advanced stats for all 32 NFL teams in the 2026 regular season, through Week 8 (data as of 2026-11-04): EPA and success rate, Next Gen Stats, FTN DVOA and charting, PFR pressure, coverage, broken tackles, penalties, presnap motion, play action by QB alignment and heavy sets, snap-count personnel, special teams. The main page (https://mpatricio1.github.io/NFL-Stats/) draws its charts with JavaScript; the same data is published as plain files below.

## Data
- [Data index (no JavaScript)](https://mpatricio1.github.io/NFL-Stats/data/): all 32 teams' key numbers in one HTML table, plus links to every file
- [team_summary.csv](https://mpatricio1.github.io/NFL-Stats/data/team_summary.csv): one row per team, every team-level stat
- [data.json](https://mpatricio1.github.io/NFL-Stats/data/data.json): the full dataset the page uses
- [README.md](https://mpatricio1.github.io/NFL-Stats/data/README.md): file list and column definitions
- [commentary.md](https://mpatricio1.github.io/NFL-Stats/data/commentary.md): written analysis for every team and section

## Past seasons (2022-2025)
- [2025 data.json](https://mpatricio1.github.io/NFL-Stats/data/seasons/2025/data.json) and [2025 season reviews](https://mpatricio1.github.io/NFL-Stats/data/seasons/2025/reviews.md): full regular season, same structure as the 2026 data.json, plus a hand-written end-of-year summary per team
- [2024 data.json](https://mpatricio1.github.io/NFL-Stats/data/seasons/2024/data.json) and [2024 season reviews](https://mpatricio1.github.io/NFL-Stats/data/seasons/2024/reviews.md): full regular season, same structure as the 2026 data.json, plus a hand-written end-of-year summary per team
- [2023 data.json](https://mpatricio1.github.io/NFL-Stats/data/seasons/2023/data.json) and [2023 season reviews](https://mpatricio1.github.io/NFL-Stats/data/seasons/2023/reviews.md): full regular season, same structure as the 2026 data.json, plus a hand-written end-of-year summary per team
- [2022 data.json](https://mpatricio1.github.io/NFL-Stats/data/seasons/2022/data.json) and [2022 season reviews](https://mpatricio1.github.io/NFL-Stats/data/seasons/2022/reviews.md): full regular season, same structure as the 2026 data.json, plus a hand-written end-of-year summary per team
